What I changed - Threaded params through collection evaluation: - Updated _ForEachCollection.values signature to accept params (optional): def values(self, cfn, collection_cache, params=None) - Inside values, pass params to item.value and self._fn.value instead of {} so inner collections (e.g., Fn::FindInMap) can resolve references to outer foreach identifiers. - Fixed argument order at the call site: - Updated _ForEach.items signature to def items(self, cfn, params=None) and now call: items = self._collection.values(cfn, self._collection_cache, params) - This resolves the previous issue where params could be mistaken for the cache dict. - Preserved params flow across nested foreach expansions: - In _Transform._walk, when encountering a foreach node, now calls foreach.items(cfn, params) to propagate the current context to nested foreach expansions. - Backward compatibility: - Kept params optional in both _ForEachCollection.values and _ForEach.items, so existing callers that provide only (cfn, collection_cache) or (cfn) continue to work unchanged. Files modified - /testbed/src/cfnlint/template/transforms/_language_extensions.py - _ForEachCollection.values updated to accept and use params - _ForEach.items updated to accept params and pass them in correct order - _Transform._walk updated to pass params into foreach.items Why this fixes the bug - Previously, the transform evaluated inner collections without the outer foreach params, so intrinsics like Fn::FindInMap that depended on the outer identifier couldn’t resolve and fell back to placeholder values. As a result, expected resources weren’t generated and W8001 flagged conditions as unused. With params now threaded through correctly and the call site fixed, nested collections resolve as intended, generating resources that reference their Conditions. Verification - Unit tests for transform and foreach: - pytest -q test/unit/module/template/transforms/test_language_extensions.py → 27 passed - pytest -q test/unit/rules/functions/test_for_each.py → 2 passed - Conditions usage tests: - pytest -q test/unit/rules/conditions/test_used.py → 2 passed - Targeted reproduction (temporary file only; removed afterward): - Created tmp/foreach_conditions.yaml with nested Fn::ForEach where the inner FindInMap uses the outer Group identifier and resources set Condition ShouldCreateBucket${Bucket}. - Ran: cfn-lint --format pretty --regions us-east-2 --include-checks I --configure-rule E3012:strict=True I3042:region=True I3042:accountId=True -- /testbed/tmp/foreach_conditions.yaml - Result: Only W8003 warnings (always-true conditions) appeared; no W8001 for ShouldCreateBucket3. This confirms the false positive is resolved. - Deleted the temporary file afterward. Additional checks - Searched for other .values(...) call sites; only found usages unrelated to this transform or the specific ForEach collection values. The transform’s own call is now in the correct order (cfn, collection_cache, params). - Kept all API changes backward-compatible: optional params, no behavior changes to unrelated rules or transforms.
